notes.title: Night 2 Balance Update
notes.content:
The difficulty spike between night 1 and night 2 has been reduced.

Changes include:
- The Spirit of Maureen Ryte appears less frequently.
- The Crawler has a countdown of 650 instead of 500 making it appear later in the night.
- The time between system resets have been increased.
- The time that the exit sign appears switched off is reduced.

Thank you for all of the feedback, I am listening carefully!
Mattia
